# Turn off two-factor
{: .no_toc }

Disable TOTP with a current code or a recovery code.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `ACC-06` |
| **Route** | `/account/security/2fa/disable` · deep link `substratal://account/security/2fa/disable` |
